name: Notes
author: Brett
description: The console's Notes screen is AmberX's own notes and to-do manager: AmberX's Notes page (Inbox, Lists, Notes, Pinned, Search, the item editor, lists and export) framed in the console as an embed@1 view page, on the same amberx.items / amberx.lists store every device reads on axHub. No second notes store. Deep links: console_open notes with focus item:<id> | list:<id> | search:<text> | add | a tab name (action notes.focus:<focus>). Reading and changing items without the UI is control@1 (REST /api/control, MCP amberx_*, CLI axf note | todo | task | list, AmberX voice). migrate.mjs moves a todo-store@1 file (the retired Todo manager's) into amberx.items.
